movimento: Sentado no banco Scott, com os pés chapados no chão e o tronco quase em pé, apoia a parte de trás dos 2 braços na almofada inclinada, com as axilas perto da borda de cima e os ombros dobrados uns 50°, e segura a barra com as palmas viradas pra cima (pegada supinada), as mãos na largura dos ombros e os punhos retos. Começa com os cotovelos quase esticados, sem travar, e sobe a barra na direção dos ombros dobrando só os cotovelos, até o antebraço chegar perto da vertical, com a barra passando na frente do rosto sem encostar nele; depois desce devagar até os braços ficarem quase esticados de novo, sem tirar os braços da almofada e sem impulso.

cinesiologia.plano: sagital (flexão e extensão dos cotovelos), com os 2 braços parados na almofada à frente do tronco (os ombros dobrados ~50°); os 2 braços juntos, na mesma barra
cinesiologia.articulacoes: cotovelos (flexão na subida, de ~15° até ~127°, com o antebraço a ~8° da vertical em cima; extensão na descida, até quase esticar, sem travar), com os antebraços supinados e os punhos retos; ombros parados, dobrados ~50° com os braços na almofada, e as escápulas um pouco pra trás e pra baixo; tronco parado, ~4° à frente, com a cabeça na linha dele; quadril (~79°) e joelhos (~75°) parados, sentado, com os pés chapados no chão
cinesiologia.agonistas: braquial e bíceps braquial — o catálogo do app põe "Bíceps braquial (cabeça curta) · braquial"; a ExRx põe o braquial como alvo da Barbell Preacher Curl ("Target Brachialis") e o bíceps como sinergista ("Synergists Biceps Brachii, Brachioradialis"), e diz que a cabeça longa trabalha mais que a curta ("The long head (lateral head) of Biceps Brachii is activated significantly more than short head (medial head)"); NSCA, na rosca com barra: "Biceps brachii, brachialis, brachioradialis". Contração concêntrica na subida e excêntrica na descida
cinesiologia.sinergistas: braquiorradial (ExRx: "Brachioradialis"); Yessis inclui o pronador redondo com carga alta ("The pronator teres comes into play when the resistance is sufficiently great")
cinesiologia.estabilizadores: flexores do punho (ExRx: "Wrist Flexors"), que seguram os punhos retos na barra
cinesiologia.fases: concêntrica (dobra os cotovelos levando a barra pros ombros, até o antebraço chegar perto da vertical, a barra na frente do rosto) e excêntrica (desce devagar até quase esticar os braços, sem travar e sem impulso)

referencias: ExRx.net — Barbell Preacher Curl (https://exrx.net/WeightExercises/Brachialis/BBPreacherCurl, lido na cópia do Internet Archive de 02/02/2026; o site responde 403 direto): classificação "Utility: Auxiliary", "Mechanics: Isolated", "Force: Pull"; Preparation: "Sit on preacher bench placing back of arms on pad. Grasp curl bar with shoulder width underhand grip."; Execution: "Raise bar until forearms are vertical. Lower barbell until arms are fully extended. Repeat."; Comments: "Seat should be adjusted to allow armpit to rest near top of pad. Back of upper arm should remain on pad throughout movement. The long head (lateral head) of Biceps Brachii is activated significantly more than short head (medial head) of Biceps Brachii since short head enters into active insufficiency as it continues to contract. Also known as Scott Curl."; músculos: Target "Brachialis", Synergists "Biceps Brachii", "Brachioradialis", Stabilizers "Wrist Flexors". A "curl bar" da ExRx é a barra W (a peça dela é do lote 13): aqui vai a barra reta, a da Nunes et al. 2020. O GIF animado da página (BBPreacherCurl.gif, "© 2012 ExRx.net", cópia de 16/09/2019) mostra sentado no banco Scott, os 2 braços na almofada, a barra descendo até os braços quase esticados, depois da borda de baixo da almofada, e subindo até a frente do rosto

Pinto RS, Gomes N, Radaelli R, Botton CE, Brown LE, Bottaro M. Effect of range of motion on muscle strength and thickness. J Strength Cond Res. 2012;26(8):2140-2145 (a revista da NSCA; PDF completo lido em 09/10/2026): a rosca Scott com barra dos 2 braços — "a bilateral mode preacher curl exercise with the radioulnar joint supinated using a curling bar. During the test, subjects were seated with both feet on the floor. The height of the preacher curl bench was adjusted for each subject so the trunk was straight, whereas the back of the arm and the axillae were rested on the pad."; "the FULL group performed elbow flexion with full (0° to 130° of elbow flexion – 0° full elbow extension) ROM, whereas the PART group performed partial (50° to 100°) ROM"

Nunes JP, Jacinto JL, Ribeiro AS, et al. Placing Greater Torque at Shorter or Longer Muscle Lengths? Effects of Cable vs. Barbell Preacher Curl Training on Muscular Strength and Hypertrophy in Young Adults. Int J Environ Res Public Health. 2020;17(16):5859. doi:10.3390/ijerph17165859 (texto completo e figura 1, PMC7460162, lidos em 09/10/2026): "The preacher curl exercises (Ipiranga, Fitness Line, Presidente Prudente, Brazil) were performed in 3 sets of 8–12 repetitions, in the maximum range of motion"; "For both groups, participants were instructed to hold the straight handle (or the bar) with hands supinated and shoulder-width apart."; no teste: "The elbow was supported on a padded shelf with the shoulder flexed at an angle of 60°, similar to the preacher bench." A figura 1 (BAR) mostra a rosca Scott sentado, com barra reta e anilhas, os 2 braços na almofada

NSCA — Exercise technique (Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning), no resumo do Achievable CSCS, cap. 15 (https://app.achievable.me/study/cscs/learn/exercise-technique-for-free-weight-and-machine-training-exercise-list-part-2, lido em 09/10/2026; não tem a rosca Scott — a rosca com barra é a mais perto): Barbell biceps curl — "Major muscles involved: Biceps brachii, brachialis, brachioradialis"; "Grasp the bar with a closed, supinated grip (shoulder-width)."; "Flex your elbows to raise the bar toward your anterior deltoids."; "Keep your torso and upper arms stationary."; "Lower the bar until your elbows fully extend."

American Council on Exercise — Seated Biceps Curl, Exercise Library (https://www.acefitness.org/resources/everyone/exercise-library/184/seated-biceps-curl/, "Equipment: Weight Machines / Selectorized", lido em 09/10/2026 — a rosca Scott na máquina; a Exercise Library do ACE não tem a rosca Scott com barra): "Sit in the machine, placing your arms over the incline pad."; "Grasp the handles firmly with a full grip (thumbs clasped around the handles) and maintain a neutral wrist position (wrists aligned with your forearms)."; "Your elbows should be extended, but not fully locked."; "Stiffen (“brace”) your abdominal muscles to stabilize your spine, and attempt to avoid movement in your low back throughout the exercise."; "Align your head with your spine, and depress and retract your scapulae (pull shoulders back and down)"; "stopping when your arms are extended, but not locked and the backs of your forearms make light contact with the incline pad"

Yessis M (Dr. Yessis SportLab) — Preacher Curl (https://doctoryessis.com/2013/01/01/preacher-curl/, lido em 09/10/2026; ele prefere o banco em pé e a barra W): "Adjust the pad height so that you have a fairly erect position."; "Hold an E-Z curl bar (or dumbbells) with a supinated (palms up) grip. The arms should be fairly straight but have a slight bend in the elbows."; "Raise the bar at a moderate rate of speed until the forearms are vertical or slightly beyond."; "Be sure to keep the upper arms in contact with the bench at all times."; "you should not completely straighten the arm in the down position. This is especially important when you use heavy weights."; "The biceps brachii, brachialis, brachioradialis, and the pronator teres muscles are involved."

folgas.nome: a barra não encosta na almofada

folgas.nome: a barra não encosta na estrutura do banco (tubos e ganchos)
